items.title: Why are good developers so wary of agentic development?
items.summary:
For me it breaks the rule of "Network of trust". Software works because someone is accountable for it. Pair Programming, Test Driven Development, and now Agentic coding all to one degree or another damage the network of trust. - Pair Programming  (There is no one person accountable for the change.)
- Test Driven Development (The test pass, so my software is good)
- Agentic Coding (My prompt was good, so my software is good) AI is great for software development... As long as you review
